## v0.6.0

**Highlights:** Releases on the Releases page now expand to show their notes, the way GitHub does. The Activity section is gone from the page.

### Features

- **release:** Click a release to expand its GitHub release notes in a dropdown (falls back to the saved notes file).
- **release:** Remove the Activity section from the Releases page.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0
